people: Royal Family Member and Military Officer

people.en: Left Vice Director of the Palace Inspection Bureau

translationRepairs: After he killed Xizong, he sent for Prince of Ge Zong Min.
After he killed Xizong, he had the Prince of Ge summon Zong Min.

s0096 使葛王宗敏, with s0097 identifying 葛王 as Shizong's first title and s0098 treating 宗敏 as a separate person summoned by Hailing, shows two people; the idiomatic wrongly fuses them, and separating Ge Wang as the agent who summons Zong Min matches the Chinese.
Kexi was fierce in battle beyond others, cruel and eager for disorder; a grandson of Taizu in the yi line, he nursed no small designs.
Kexi was fierce in battle beyond others, cruel and eager for disorder; as a grandson of Taizu, he nursed no small designs.
Chapter 自乙太祖孫 yields no meaningful 'yi line'; CText Jinshi ch. 69 reads 自以太祖孫 ('regarding himself as Taizu's grandson'), so dropping the invented lineage phrase is the correct repair.
In the twenty-third year, Shuang's illness lingered. An edict instructed the offices: "When Prince Rong's mourning leave reaches one hundred days, he shall receive a prince's stipend."
In the twenty-third year, Shuang's illness lingered. An edict instructed the offices: "When Prince Rong's sick leave reaches one hundred days, he shall receive a prince's stipend."
s0037 opens with 爽疾久不愈 and the edict 榮王告滿百日; 告 here is sick leave during lingering illness (death only at s0038 既薨), so 'mourning leave' is wrong and 'sick leave' is accurate.
